extracted.intended_audience: public relations practitioners / CIPR members / communications professionals
extracted.subtask_description: A professional-practice review and guide for PR practitioners on research, measurement and evaluation in public relations and communication management, covering methods, metrics, ethics, technology and strategic relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Insight into the strategic relevance and professional context of research, measurement and evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Insight into the strategic relevance and professional context of research, measurement and evaluation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide provides context on why measurement matters strategically for PR practice and situates measurement within professional responsibilities. (Page quote: the guide offers 'Insight into the strategic relevance and professional context of research, measurement and evaluation')

rubrics_metrics.name: An understanding of relevant methods, models and frameworks
rubrics_metrics.description: An understanding of relevant methods, models and frameworks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers measurement models and frameworks as core tools for evaluation. The release notes the guide 'includes an in‑depth look at measurement models and frameworks' and seeks to familiarise practitioners with appropriate methodological choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance into metrics, benchmarking and performance improvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance into metrics, benchmarking and performance improvement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical guidance on selecting and using metrics, establishing benchmarks and using measurement to drive performance improvements. The release emphasises 'Guidance into metrics, benchmarking and performance improvement' and 'benchmarking and performance improvements'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Familiarity with technological developments
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages awareness of the latest tools and technologies that affect PR research and measurement (the guide provides 'Familiarity with technological developments' and 'the latest technological developments').

rubrics_metrics.name: Reflection on ethical practice and decision‑making approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Reflection on ethical practice and decision-making approaches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promotes ethical consideration when measuring and evaluating PR activity, including decision-making frameworks. The release lists 'Reflection on ethical practice and decision-making approaches' as a key offering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Critical awareness of strategic professional practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Critical awareness of strategic professional practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages evaluative thinking about how measurement supports strategic professional practice rather than purely tactical metrics. The guide aims to build 'Critical awareness of strategic professional practice.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluate PR against criteria beyond communication effects (behavioural change)
rubrics_metrics.description: Public relations must be evaluated against criteria that go beyond communication effects into behavioural change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assessment of PR should include outcomes such as behavioural change, not only indicators of communication (e.g., reach or impressions). This principle is highlighted in the quoted commentary: 'public relations is more than communication and must be evaluated against criteria that go beyond communication effects into behavioural change.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Use rigorous academic research to underpin measurement practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Rigorous academic research underpins best-in-class PR measurement and evaluation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide synthesises academic research to inform best practice; practitioners should ground measurement approaches in robust evidence ('covering both the rigorous academic research underpinning best in class PR measurement and evaluation').

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical insight to make well‑informed decisions on metrics and methodologies
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical insight into how to make more well-informed decisions around metrics and methodologies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond theory, the guide promises actionable guidance so practitioners can choose appropriate metrics and methods for their context ('providing practical insight into how to make more well-informed decisions around metrics and methodologies').

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to professional standards: code of conduct, accountability, CPD and qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: The CIPR advances professionalism by requiring accountability through a code of conduct and a searchable register, setting standards through training, qualifications, awards and best practice guidance, facilitating CPD and awarding professional status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measurement and evaluation practice should align with wider professional standards and ethics. The boilerplate describes institutional expectations (code of conduct, training, CPD, Chart.PR) that shape acceptable practice and accountability.
